# Eve 0.83.2 upgrade: cutover, rollback and rehearsal evidence

[ENG-16245](https://linear.app/acquisity/issue/ENG-16245) upgrades Foreman from Eve 0.81.1 to Eve 0.83.2 on the integration branch `feature/eng-16245-eve-0.83.2`. [ENG-16246](https://linear.app/acquisity/issue/ENG-16246) bumps the code ([#237](https://github.com/Acquisity/Foreman/pull/237), head `28f2d8d`). [ENG-16247](https://linear.app/acquisity/issue/ENG-16247) rehearsed the session handoff and the rollback on Preview and wrote this runbook. The upgrade follows the weekly eve upgrade decision of 2026-10-26. This file is not Production acceptance; Aaron approves the merge.

## Versions

| | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| eve | 0.81.1 | 0.83.2 |
| Session checkpoint | writes v15 | reads v8 to v17, migrates forward |
| Handoff protocol | v3 | v3 |
| Sandbox image | `vcr.vercel.com/vercel/eve/base:0.81.1` | `vcr.vercel.com/vercel/eve/base:0.83.2` |
| Sandbox provider state | provider name per eve 0.81 | provider name `"default"`, new state protocol (0.83.0) |

## Why sessions cross forward and not back

- Forward: 0.83.2 reads the v15 checkpoint 0.81.1 writes and migrates it (`node_modules/eve/dist/src/execution/session/checkpoint-migrations.js`), and both speak handoff protocol v3. 0.83.0 resumes the sandbox of a session created on an earlier eve. So an idle 0.81.1 session hands off to the 0.83.2 deployment on its next message, keeping its session id, history and sandbox. The rehearsal confirmed this for a Slack root with a sandbox file, a Slack root with native children, and a Linear Agent Session.
- Back: a session created or continued on 0.83 records its sandbox under the new provider state, which 0.81.1 cannot open. In the rehearsal, a 0.83.2 session that was not reset did not fail on rollback: eve 0.83.2 offered the session to the 0.81.1 deployment (`startSuccessorStep`), the 0.81.1 successor ran `prepareSuccessorStep` and stopped, and the 0.83.2 run recorded `reportSessionHandoffRetainedStep` and kept answering on the old 0.83.2 deployment. An unreset session therefore keeps running upgraded code on the retained deployment, silently, for as long as that deployment serves. Rollback must reset every session that ran on 0.83.2.

## Production cutover

The forward handoff passed, so the cutover is snapshot first, then merge. No drain or reset is needed going forward. If a rehearsal fails before the merge, choose the drain-and-reset procedure in [EVE-0811-UPGRADE.md](./EVE-0811-UPGRADE.md), using 0.81.1 as the old version and 0.83.2 as the new version.

0. Snapshot. Record the current Production and general Preview `VERCEL_SANDBOX_BASE_SNAPSHOT_ID` values in private operator notes (read them with `npx vercel env pull --environment <env>`; the env API's `decrypt=true` returns ciphertext, not the id). Keep the 0.81.1 snapshot for the rollback window; never delete it. Use a warm snapshot built from `vcr.vercel.com/vercel/eve/base:0.83.2`: the rehearsal built `snap_BO5g90au24nsjCO9yfq91RwA0zrO` (expires 2026-11-25), or run `rebuild_warm_snapshot` again from an attended session on a 0.83.2 Preview deployment. Set it for Production and general Preview immediately before the merge, and read both back. Do not redeploy the 0.81.1 Production deployment after this point: a 0.81.1 build with a 0.83.2 snapshot is unrehearsed.
1. Record the upgrade window start, then merge the integration branch to `main`. Verify the Production deployment is READY on the expected SHA (`npx vercel api "/v13/deployments/<host>?teamId=team_ZU8UTsvGgsLZaLDc8pUAzict" --scope acquisity`, `meta.githubCommitSha`), and record every 0.83.2 `deploymentId`. Read the Production alias with `npx vercel api /v13/deployments/foreman-sigma.vercel.app --scope acquisity`: its `id` and `meta.githubCommitSha` must match that deployment, and `https://foreman-sigma.vercel.app/eve/v1/health` must return 200 before resuming triggers. Keep the last 0.81.1 Production deployment URL for rollback.
2. Continue one existing Slack thread and one Linear session. Pass when the run is served by the new deployment with `$eve.version` 0.83.2 and its `$eve.session` attribute equal to the session's original run id (`npx workflow inspect runs <runId> -b vercel -e production --project foreman --team acquisity -j`), and the reply uses earlier context. Then open one fresh session and run a sandbox command.
3. If any continuation starts fresh, fails or loses its sandbox after the merge, pause both triggers and the session-starting schedules. Inventory as in Rollback step 2, covering both versions and any still-open 0.81.1 sessions from before the upgrade window. Reset each session through the deployment that owns it now, identified by the `deploymentId` of its newest run: sessions that never handed off through the retained 0.81.1 deployment, upgraded sessions through their 0.83.2 deployment. Keep and reconcile reset results as in Rollback step 3. Then either verify the 0.83.2 alias and health as in step 1 and resume the recorded triggers and schedules (every thread starts a fresh session with visible history), or run the Rollback section.

## Rollback

1. Pause the Slack and Linear connector triggers (`{"destinations":[]}` PATCH to `/v1/connect/connectors/<id>/trigger-destinations`, read back `triggerDestinations: null`) and the session-starting schedules. Record the destinations first.
2. Inventory every session that ran on a 0.83.2 deployment: `npx workflow inspect runs -b vercel -e production --project foreman --team acquisity -j --since <window-start> --limit 100`. Keep the JSON from the first `{` line onward; follow `.cursor` with `--cursor <c>` on the same command until empty, saving every page before filtering by the recorded 0.83.2 `deploymentId`s. Record the upgrade window start and every upgraded deployment id with the inventory. Include `workflowEntry` and `taskRunWorkflow` runs, including subagents; `sessionTimeoutWorkflow` runs are timers and need no reset. Deduplicate by session id (`$eve.session`, else the run id), and keep each session's newest run and owning deployment.
3. Reset each session through its owning immutable 0.83.2 deployment host: `curl -X POST https://<host>/eve/v1/session/<sessionId>/reset -H "Authorization: Bearer $OIDC" -H "x-vercel-trusted-oidc-idp-token: $OIDC" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'`, with `$OIDC` from `npx vercel env pull --environment development`, never printed. Keep a per-session reset result; expect `reset`, or `no_active_session` for a child already settled. Retry failed resets through the current 0.83.2 Production host, then use `npx workflow cancel <runId> -b vercel -e production --project foreman --team acquisity` for each remaining session/task run. Before the revert, repeat the full paginated inventory and reconcile it against the reset results: any remaining upgraded session or task, failed reset or missing page blocks rollback until resolved.
4. Restore Production and general Preview `VERCEL_SANDBOX_BASE_SNAPSHOT_ID` to the recorded 0.81.1 values, then deploy a revert commit on `main`. Never `vercel rollback`. Verify READY on the revert SHA, then read `npx vercel api /v13/deployments/foreman-sigma.vercel.app --scope acquisity`: its `id` and `meta.githubCommitSha` must match the revert deployment, and `https://foreman-sigma.vercel.app/eve/v1/health` must return 200.
5. Before resuming, repeat the full paginated inventory and reconciliation in steps 2 and 3; any remaining upgraded session or task, failed reset or missing page blocks resumption. Only after that and the alias and health checks pass, restore the recorded trigger destinations and schedules, read them back, and continue a Slack thread and a Linear session: each starts a fresh 0.81.1 session with visible history; sandbox files are not carried over.

## Rehearsal transcript

Forward. The 0.81.1 Preview at `a799536` was READY as `dpl_J4inLSxrRzCeunygR3sE9CHBuRrj` with the general Preview 0.81.1 snapshot set branch-scoped. Pushing a SHA already built for `main` produced no deployment; it was created with `POST /v13/deployments` and a GitHub `gitSource`, no `target`. Thread A (`1793021082.995949`) wrote `/workspace/handoff-a.txt` at 13:24:52Z. Thread B (`1793021084.644729`) ran two native delegates and replied once. SAN-85 answered through the Foreman Preview agent. The `28f2d8d` push auto-deployed; it was redeployed after the branch snapshot was cleared as `dpl_AYQdJh7mLXcJEWocaTo9CHJYNxZ1`. Deleting a branch-scoped `VERCEL_SANDBOX_BASE_SNAPSHOT_ID` falls back to the general Preview value, so the cold clone used a branch-scoped empty value (`agent/sandbox.ts` omits `source` when it is falsy). At 13:28:48 to 13:28:59 each session's next message created a continuation run on the 0.83.2 deployment whose `$eve.session` and `$parentRunId` name the original run, and the old roots' 0.81.1 timeout timers were cancelled. Thread A replied with the codeword and the file contents written on 0.81.1 (`1793021339.085829`), thread B with both earlier answers plus a new delegate (`1793021365.198039`), SAN-85 with its codeword and a fresh read. Vercel logs showed no `session handoff` or checkpoint-version line; they drop ops lines, so the run attributes are the evidence.

Snapshot. Thread A ran `rebuild_warm_snapshot` (`1793021632.565149`): `snap_BO5g90au24nsjCO9yfq91RwA0zrO`, created 13:33:39Z, 1.70 GB, source sandbox `sbx_RosgZb7a7tY8vhu3fITlVxU3RwJL`. The tool returns no image name; at `28f2d8d` `eveSandboxImage()` resolves `vcr.vercel.com/vercel/eve/base:<installed eve>` = `base:0.83.2`, and no Vercel environment sets `EVE_SANDBOX_IMAGE_TAG`. With it set branch-scoped, `dpl_2FjvuGhudYsFXQVkvXv37AePcnpf` prepared both sandbox templates from it, and a fresh thread D session ran bash in `/workspace` (node v24.22.1) and listed both warm checkouts under `/workspace/.foreman/warm` at `a799536`. The 0.83 image has no `/vercel/sandbox`.

Rollback. Both triggers were paused at 13:46:00Z and 13:46:03Z (`triggerDestinations: null`). Resets through `foreman-qyrg67dy8-acquisity.vercel.app` at 13:46:27 to 13:46:32 returned `reset` for the three roots, the 0.83.2 child and one 0.81.1 child, and `no_active_session` for the other 0.81.1 child. `a799536` was pushed back with the 0.81.1 snapshot; the API deployment `dpl_2Cg63S2gu7AvNgAqF1TkRdjBvjTD` took the alias, and the push also auto-deployed `dpl_6qMoSRm5iK8uWbP3dFYzc6PFRqa8` at the same SHA. Triggers resumed at 13:48:20Z. Threads A and B and SAN-85 each started a fresh 0.81.1 session that read the visible history; thread A reported `/workspace/handoff-a.txt` missing. Thread D was not reset and was retained on the 0.83.2 deployment as described above (reply `1793022523.283129`). After D was reset through the 0.83.2 host at 13:53:43Z, its next message started fresh session `wrun_41M5W7T6VF0GVDY53FWSHXXF27`. The five rollback sessions were then reset through the 0.81.1 host, both triggers restored to `feature/eng-15868-eve-0.81.1` at 13:55:32Z and 13:55:34Z and read back with one destination each, and the branch environment removed.

Not exercised: replacing and restoring the Production and general Preview snapshot values, quieting Production schedules, and the widget path.
